title: Orsen and the Harbor
author: Odile Reyes
blurb: Isandro Vane, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
